title: deck source ledger
description: EXTRACTION, KEPT SEPARATE FROM REASONING. The agenda and the storyboard are built from this file, never from a summary of the source: a summary is where a number loses its unit, an unresolved action becomes a finished one, and a decision acquires a certainty the minutes never had. Every entry therefore carries `quote`, the EXACT source wording, and `deck gate ledger` verifies that each quote really occurs in the saved source text. An entry whose quote cannot be found is a fabrication, and it is refused by name.

kind.description: The four things worth carrying forward from a meeting. Anything else belongs in the agent's own prose, not in the ledger.

source_id.description: Which manifest source this came from.

block_id.description: The Notion block id, when there was one, so the PO can click back to it.

quote.description: VERBATIM from the source text. Whitespace may be collapsed; nothing else may change. This is checked, not trusted.

status.description: A decision is resolved or unresolved; an action is done or pending. NEVER record an action as done because it sounds finished - only because the source says so. The agenda gate requires every unresolved and pending entry to be either on the agenda or explicitly excluded with a reason.

due.description: Verbatim as the source wrote it. Do not normalise 来週 into a date.

value.description: The number as written, including separators.

unit.description: 円, %, 人, 件. A number without its unit is not a number.

period.description: Which period it describes. Two numbers for different months are not a trend.

conflicts_with.description: Ids of entries this one contradicts. Minutes do contradict themselves; recording it is how the agent avoids silently picking one.

note.description: The agent's own remark. Never a substitute for the quote.

source_omits.description: Fields the SOURCE genuinely does not state. Recording the absence is the honest answer; inventing an owner or inferring a period is exactly what these gates exist to prevent. Every entry with a non-empty source_omits must be raised at the agenda gate, so the hole becomes a question for the room.
